source.title: Electrostatics: Maze Game
source.observed_goal: Use an understanding of charged objects to guide an object through a maze and reach the target before time runs out.

preserved: fixed positive and negative field objects
maze navigation to a marked target
changed: the source simulation is rebuilt as a self-contained benchmark canvas
the bead has visible retained velocity and the charge input is sampled during motion
the full interaction uses a three-detent physical charge dial while simplified uses labelled buttons
the server independently replays the force field, maze rails, gate crossings, and exit ring

implementation_notes.verification_boundary: Visible geometry and normal pointer input are the only task controls; hidden truth is used only by the independent server/export verifier.
